dct_title_s: Nepal Flood 2026: fAIr Damage Assessment, Upper Trishuli and Bhote Koshi
dct_description_sm: Part of the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team response activation for the 26 August 2026 Bhote Koshi and Trishuli flash flood in Nepal. AI-scored building damage per OpenStreetMap footprint across the upper Trishuli and Bhote Koshi corridor, from Rasuwagadhi to the Narayani confluence. Post imagery is a 26-scene Vantor open-data composite (2026-08-27 to 2026-09-08, roughly 0.4 m/px, about 9.8% cloud). Pre imagery is ESRI World Imagery, served live from ESRI and not redistributed here. Buildings combine standing (`building=*`) and mapper-tagged destroyed (`destroyed:building=*`) OpenStreetMap features; 22,624 buildings scored. Each feature carries `osm_id`, `osm_type`, `building`, `damage_class` (-1..3), a `damage` label (`no-visible-damage`, `minor-damage`, `major-damage`, `destroyed`, `no-data`) and a `damage_confidence`. Evaluated and validated against 2,681 OSM mapper-tagged `destroyed:building` lifecycle features (2026-09-11): destroyed precision 0.80, recall 0.76, F1 0.78; severe (major + destroyed) recall 0.88. The reference layer is included in this dataset. For the wider corridor context, see [Nepal Flood 2026 Flood Affected Area](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hot_flood_npl). - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/), Vantor open data, ESRI World Imagery - Part of HOT disaster response exports on HDX by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
